verdicts.quote: Automatic promotion. When a seat frees, the first Waiting member is booked at once. There is no offer or claim window.
Order is first-come, first-served by join time, per class. No priority tiers. ... two members joining at the same instant still get two different positions (R-8).
What booking rules (credits, membership, overlap) and cutoff time apply, and should a member who fails them be skipped or kept?
verdicts.missing: Whether promoting a member into one class cancels or otherwise resolves their waitlist entry for an overlapping class.

verdicts.quote: Exclusions: payments, credits, late-cancel fees, no-show handling ... Any existing rule of these kinds still applies at promotion (D-4); the waitlist adds none of its own.
verdicts.missing: Whether a promotion the member did not want or misses (e.g. auto-booked close to start, then cancels or no-shows) counts against the existing late-cancel/no-show policy.

verdicts.quote: This happens as part of the operation that freed the seat. ... promotion runs inside the operation that freed the seat (member cancel, capacity increase), so there is no scheduled sweeper

told, on the app's existing notification channel and also on the member's own class view ... if notification delivery fails, the Booking still stands and the class view still shows the truth; the failure is logged
operations on one class behave as if applied one at a time ... a repeated cancel ... must not trigger a second promotion ... Bookings never above 2.
Member already has a live entry | Member joins again, or tries to book | Nothing | WAITLISTED(current position); no new entry, position unchanged
Exclusions: payments, credits ... Any existing rule of these kinds still applies at promotion (D-4); the waitlist adds none of its own.
verdicts.missing: When payment for a promoted booking is taken and what happens if that payment fails (beyond the generic skip on failed booking rules).

verdicts.quote: No cap on waitlist length and no per-member limit on how many waitlists they join.
Waitlist is open exactly while the class is Open and Full, so it follows the existing booking cutoff and never extends past class start. ... Promotion happens only while the class is Open
a capacity raise from 2 to 4 with two waiting promotes both, in order ... capacity decrease below current bookings (existing behaviour, no waitlist effect: Waiting entries stay
If staff cancel the class, Waiting entries become Closed and the waiting members are told (R-6).
Waitlist entry, states Waiting, Promoted, Left, Skipped, Closed ... Position: 1 plus the number of Waiting entries ahead of it for that class.
Leaves Waiting on promote, leave, skip, class start, class cancel. Terminal records are kept no longer than the class's booking records
A member sees only their own entry and position; never who else is waiting.
Exclusions ... staff view of the waitlist, waitlist counts, and any waitlist-specific permissions for staff.
verdicts.missing: Staff viewing the waitlist, manually promoting or removing someone, and seeing promotion history are excluded rather than specified.

verdicts.quote: when the cancel call returns, the promotion has already been applied, so a following read shows the promoted Booking.
booking a class with free seats, cancelling a booking, class listings and any existing cancellation policy behave exactly as before
Additive: no change to existing booking data.
verdicts.missing: Whether classes already full at release gain a waitlist, and how that is handled.
